verses.1: The Song of the Songs for Moses.
verses.2: May they fill me with their sweet kisses, for they are truly good ones. From whom do you receive them?
verses.3: To smell your good names, to hear your name be praised. Thus, those who love you will live in peace.
verses.4: Let me dwell with you. May the king bring me into his chambers. Let me be happy in your presence. I will remember your kindness from the past. I love you.
verses.5: I am black, and I am also a daughter of Jerusalem. I am like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.6: Do not think that I am a worthless person, as if the sun has scorched me. My children have rejected me; they have abandoned me. The vineyards are overgrown with weeds; they were not properly tended by me.
verses.7: She told me that love can be both cruel and tender. In the evenings, it will be like a storm upon your friends’ homes.
verses.8: If you don’t know, the beauty of women lies in their ability to follow the traces of sheep. So, chase after your enemies and destroy their homes.
verses.9: In my dreams, I ride on Pharaoh’s chariots. My sorrows are like those of a captive.
verses.10: May your life be filled with joy and happiness.
verses.11: Golden vessels were made with the filings from silver.
verses.12: Until the king was taken away, Nirdi gave off a smell.
verses.13: May the Lord, my father, bless me between these two places.
verses.14: May the sheep of the flock be with me in the vineyards of Ein Gedi.
verses.15: You are beautiful, my beloved. Your eyes are beautiful, oh my eyes!
verses.16: You are beautiful, my father. Even though our wounds are still there, they are healing now.
verses.17: Our children’s toys are broken; our furniture is in a state of disrepair.
